entries.015fb060c9c6f024: This is a business operating supermarkets that sell fresh food, processed food, daily necessities and other goods mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area, centered on Saitama Prefecture. The group consists of retail alone as a single segment, so revenue by business is not disclosed. As of February 28, 2026, there were 151 stores in total: 148 under the Belc brand and 3 under the Kurube brand, and revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥416,514 million (109.2% year on year). Consolidated subsidiary Homu Derika manufactures prepared foods and the like, Joitech supplies sales materials and handles cleaning, Maruichi Suisan ＬＴＤ processes and wholesales fresh and frozen fish, and Nakamura Beihan handles milling and sale of rice, and these companies supply products and services to the stores. The eight categories below are sales results by product, which are listed by product because the business is a single segment.
